# Simplyes

> Simplyes is an independent private assistance service that helps Indians living in Germany understand and prepare for Indian consular and administrative processes. Simplyes is not a government authority and is not affiliated with, authorised by, or acting on behalf of the Embassy of India, the Consulates General of India, or any outsourced application centre.

- Tagline: Redefining Consular Services
- Coverage: We assist customers across Germany.
- Contact: WhatsApp +49 176 62510556 (https://wa.me/4917662510556)
- Language: English

Simplyes helps with: understanding application requirements, checking whether documents appear complete, preparing and reviewing forms, formatting photos and signatures to stated requirements, explaining appointment-related steps, and clarifying the next step.

Simplyes does not: issue passports or visas, approve or decide applications, guarantee or reserve appointments, or speed up official processing. Official requirements, fees, processing and decisions are handled by the respective authorities or their designated service providers.
